汤隆，绰号「金钱豹子」，善打铁，使铁瓜锤。其父曾任延安府知寨官。父亲死后，他因好.en:
Tang Long, the Coin-Spotted Leopard, was a blacksmith who wielded an iron melon hammer. His father had served as a fort commandant in Yan'an. After his father's death, gambling left Tang Long wandering, and he made his living at the forge. Pockmarks on his body gave him his nickname. Li Kui saw him handling his hammer, admired his skill, and invited him to Liangshan. Tang Long went along with Li Kui and Gongsun Sheng.

When Huyan Zhuo's linked cavalry defeated Liangshan, Tang Long proposed hooked lances and recommended his cousin Xu Ning as instructor. He arranged for Shi Qian to steal Xu Ning's armor, led Xu Ning after it, and had him drugged and brought to the mountain. He also brought Xu Ning's family there, securing his stay to teach the technique.

Tang Long ranked eighty-eighth, corresponding to the Earthly Solitary Star, and supervised the manufacture of weapons and armor. During the attack on Qingxi against Fang La, he was seriously wounded and died when treatment failed.
汤隆，绰号「金钱豹子」，善打铁，使铁瓜锤。其父曾任延安府知寨官。父亲死后，他因好.ja:
湯隆は鍛冶に長け、鉄瓜鎚を使い、「金銭豹子」と呼ばれた。父は延安府の知寨官を務めていた。父の死後、賭け事のために流浪し、鍛冶で暮らしていた。体にあばたがあることが異名の由来である。鎚を使う姿を見た李逵に腕を認められ、梁山泊へ誘われて、李逵、公孫勝と同行した。

呼延灼の連環馬に梁山泊が苦戦すると、湯隆は鉤鎌槍を使う策を出し、従兄の徐寧を師として勧めた。時遷に鎧を盗ませ、自ら徐寧を追跡に誘い、薬で眠らせて山へ運んだ。さらに家族も連れてきて、徐寧にとどまって槍法を教えさせた。

席次は第八十八位、地孤星に当たり、兵器と鉄甲の製造を監督した。方臘征討の清渓攻めで重傷を負い、治療の甲斐なく亡くなった。

陶宗旺，光州人，庄家田户出身，绰号「九尾龟」。他力气大，惯使铁锹，也会使枪抡刀，.en:
Tao Zongwang, the Nine-Tailed Turtle, came from a farming household in Guangzhou Prefecture. A strong man who wielded an iron shovel as well as spear and saber, he was the fourth leader of Yellow Gate Mountain, alongside Ou Peng, Jiang Jing, and Ma Lin.

After escaping Jiangzhou and taking revenge at Wuwei, Song Jiang passed Yellow Gate Mountain on his way to Liangshan. Its four leaders welcomed and entertained the party, then gathered their followers and property and joined Liangshan. Tao Zongwang ranked seventy-fifth, corresponding to the Earthly Principles Star, and supervised the construction of the stronghold's defensive walls.

During the assault on Runzhou against Fang La, Tao Zongwang died with Song Wan and Jiao Ting. The novel collectively describes the three as killed by arrows and trampled by horses, without detailing each death separately. Song Jiang held a memorial sacrifice, and they were buried outside Runzhou's eastern gate.
陶宗旺，光州人，庄家田户出身，绰号「九尾龟」。他力气大，惯使铁锹，也会使枪抡刀，.ja:
陶宗旺は光州の農家出身で、「九尾亀」と呼ばれた。力が強く、鉄の鍬を使い、槍や刀も扱った。黄門山で欧鵬、蔣敬、馬麟と仲間を集め、第四の頭領となっていた。

宋江が江州を脱出し、無為軍で仇を討って梁山泊へ戻る途中、黄門山を通った。四人の頭領は山を下りて一行を迎え、もてなした後、兵や財物をまとめて梁山泊に加わった。陶宗旺は第七十五位、地理星に当たり、梁山泊の城壁建設を監督した。

方臘征討の潤州攻めでは、宋万、焦挺とともに乱戦で命を落とした。原作は三人をまとめて、矢に射られ、馬に踏まれて死んだと記し、一人ずつの最期は述べていない。宋江は祭りを行い、三人を潤州東門の外に葬った。

童猛，浔阳江边人，童威的弟弟，称「翻江蜃」。兄弟二人会水、能驾船，贩私盐，投李俊.en:
Tong Meng, the River-Churning Clam, was Tong Wei's younger brother and came from the banks of the Xunyang River. The brothers were skilled swimmers and boatmen who smuggled salt and stayed with Li Jun. During Song Jiang's journey to exile, they helped Li Jun revive him at Li Li's inn. Later, while boating, they encountered Zhang Heng about to kill him and stopped it.

After the rescue at Jiangzhou's execution ground, Tong Meng helped with the escape by water and joined Liangshan with Li Jun's company. Ranked sixty-ninth and corresponding to the Earthly Retreating Star, he became a naval commander and guarded the northwestern water camp with Ruan Xiaoqi. In the Fang La campaign he fought on the rivers and took part in the false grain-offering surrender at Qingxi.

On the return march through Suzhou, Li Jun pretended to suffer a stroke and asked Song Jiang to leave Tong Wei and Tong Meng as attendants. The three reunited with Fei Bao and his three companions and sailed from Taicang. Li Jun later became king of Siam, while the Tong brothers and their companions received offices overseas.
童猛，浔阳江边人，童威的弟弟，称「翻江蜃」。兄弟二人会水、能驾船，贩私盐，投李俊.ja:
童猛は潯陽江のほとりの出身で、童威の弟に当たり、「翻江蜃」と呼ばれた。兄弟は泳ぎと操船に長け、塩を密売して李俊の家に身を寄せていた。宋江が江州へ流される途中、李俊とともに李立の店で彼を救い、後には張横が船上で宋江を殺そうとするところを止めた。

江州の刑場襲撃後は水路での救援に加わり、李俊らと梁山泊へ入った。席次は第六十九位、地退星に当たり、水軍頭領として阮小七と西北水寨を守った。方臘征討では水戦や、兵糧の献上を装って清渓へ入る作戦に参加した。

帰路に蘇州を通った際、李俊は中風を装い、童威、童猛を看病役として残してもらった。三人は費保ら四人と落ち合い、太倉港から出航する。李俊は後に暹羅国王となり、童氏兄弟らも海外で官職に就いた。

童威，浔阳江边人，称「出洞蛟」，与弟弟童猛贩私盐，住在李俊家，会水、能操舟。兄弟.en:
Tong Wei, the Cave-Emerging Dragon, came from the banks of the Xunyang River. He and his younger brother Tong Meng smuggled salt, stayed with Li Jun, and were accomplished swimmers and boatmen. When they visited Li Li's inn with Li Jun, they found Song Jiang drugged and helped save him. They later encountered Zhang Heng about to kill Song Jiang on the river and intervened again.

After the rescue at Jiangzhou's execution ground, Tong Wei helped the river band receive Song Jiang's party. He then took part in the attack on Wuwei and went to Liangshan. Ranked sixty-eighth and corresponding to the Earthly Advancing Star, he commanded naval forces and guarded the northeastern camp with Ruan Xiaowu. Against Fang La, he joined Li Jun's false surrender with grain boats and entered Qingxi as an infiltrator.

On the return journey through Suzhou, Tong Wei and Tong Meng stayed behind to attend the supposedly ill Li Jun. His illness was a pretense: the three joined Fei Bao and his companions and sailed from Taicang. Li Jun later became king of Siam, and Tong Wei and the others also received offices there.
童威，浔阳江边人，称「出洞蛟」，与弟弟童猛贩私盐，住在李俊家，会水、能操舟。兄弟.ja:
童威は潯陽江のほとりの出身で、「出洞蛟」と呼ばれた。弟の童猛と塩を密売し、李俊の家に住み、泳ぎと操船に長けていた。李俊と李立の店を訪れた際、宋江が薬で眠らされているのを見つけて助けた。後には川で張横が宋江を殺そうとする場面に出会い、再び救った。

江州の刑場襲撃後、童威は川の仲間と宋江一行を迎え、無為軍攻撃にも加わって梁山泊へ向かった。席次は第六十八位、地進星に当たり、水軍頭領として阮小五と東北水寨を守った。方臘征討では李俊らと兵糧船での投降を装い、清渓へ潜入して内応した。

帰路に蘇州を通ると、童威と童猛は病気を装った李俊の看病のため残った。三人は費保らと合流し、太倉港から出航した。李俊は後に暹羅国王となり、童威らもその地で官職に就いた。

王定六，绰号「活闪婆」，因走跳得快得名，与父亲在建康江边卖酒。他喜欢赴水使棒，曾.en:
Wang Dingliu was called the Living Flash because of his quick running and jumping. He sold wine with his father beside the river at Jiankang. Fond of swimming and staff fighting, he had sought teachers without success. When Zhang Shun traveled to fetch An Daoquan for Song Jiang's back abscess, Zhang Wang and Sun Wu robbed him and threw him into the river. He escaped to the Wangs' inn, where father and son helped him.

Wang Dingliu supplied clothes and money and later helped lure Zhang Wang onto a boat, where Zhang Shun bound and drowned him. Having secured An Daoquan's help, Zhang Shun invited Wang Dingliu and his father to Liangshan. Wang ranked one hundred and fourth, corresponding to the Earthly Inferior Star, and ran the northern inn with Li Li.

During the assault on Xuanzhou against Fang La, Wang Dingliu and Cao Zheng were struck by poisoned arrows from the walls. Both died on returning to camp.
王定六，绰号「活闪婆」，因走跳得快得名，与父亲在建康江边卖酒。他喜欢赴水使棒，曾.ja:
王定六は走ったり跳んだりするのが速く、「活閃婆」と呼ばれ、父と建康の川辺で酒を売っていた。泳ぎと棒術を好み、何度も師を求めたが教えを得られなかった。宋江の背中の腫れ物を治すため安道全を迎えに来た張順が、張旺、孫五に金を奪われて川へ投げ込まれると、逃げ着いた王家の酒店で父子が助けた。

王定六は張順に衣服と銀を渡し、後には張旺を誘い出すのにも協力した。張順は張旺を縛って川へ投げ込み、安道全を連れ帰る際、王定六にも父と梁山泊へ来るよう勧めた。席次は第百四位、地劣星に当たり、李立と北山酒店を営んだ。

方臘征討の宣州攻めでは、曹正とともに城壁からの毒矢を受け、陣へ戻ったところで亡くなった。

王英，两淮人，因五短身材称「矮脚虎」。原是车家，途中劫取客人财物，事发后越狱，投.en:
Wang Ying came from the Huai regions and was called the Stumpy Tiger because of his short stature. Originally a carter, he robbed a passenger, escaped prison after his arrest, and joined Yan Shun and Zheng Tianshou at Qingfeng Mountain as its second leader. He tried to keep Liu Gao's wife by force until Song Jiang persuaded him to release her and promised to arrange a marriage for him.

After the troubles at Qingfeng Fort, Wang Ying joined Liangshan. During the attack on Zhu Family Manor, Hu Sanniang captured him; Lin Chong subsequently captured her. After the manor fell, Song Jiang gave her to Wang Ying in marriage. Wang Ying ranked fifty-eighth, corresponding to the Earthly Subtle Star. He and Hu Sanniang served as cavalry leaders responsible for internal military affairs.

On the approach to Muzhou during the Fang La campaign, Wang Ying fought Zheng Biao. Startled by Zheng's magic, he was killed by a spear thrust. Hu Sanniang went to his aid, but Zheng struck her in the face with a gilded copper brick, killing her too.
王英，两淮人，因五短身材称「矮脚虎」。原是车家，途中劫取客人财物，事发后越狱，投.ja:
王英は両淮の出身で、背が低いため「矮脚虎」と呼ばれた。もとは車引きだったが、客の財物を奪って捕まり、脱獄して清風山へ入り、燕順、鄭天寿とともに第二の頭領となった。劉高の妻を無理に留めようとしたが、宋江に説得されて放し、代わりに結婚の世話を約束された。

清風寨の事件後、王英は一同と梁山泊へ入った。祝家荘攻めで扈三娘に捕らえられ、その扈三娘も林沖に捕まる。荘の攻略後、宋江は扈三娘を王英の妻とした。王英は第五十八位、地微星に当たり、扈三娘とともに軍中の内務を担当する馬軍頭領となった。

方臘征討で睦州へ進む途中、鄭彪と戦い、その術に驚いたところを槍で殺された。救援に向かった扈三娘も、鄭彪が飛ばした金張りの銅磚を顔に受けて命を落とした。

魏定国，凌州团练使，精熟火攻，号「神火将」，与善用水法的单廷珪同守凌州。朝廷命二.en:
Wei Dingguo, a military commandant of Lingzhou, specialized in fire attacks and was known as the Divine Fire General. He defended the city with the water-warfare specialist Shan Tinggui. When ordered against Liangshan, they were met by Guan Sheng's force. Their red- and black-armored infantry ambushed and captured Xuan Zan and Hao Siwen, forcing Guan Sheng to retreat.

After Shan Tinggui surrendered to Guan Sheng, Wei Dingguo continued fighting with his fire troops. When Li Kui and his companions entered Lingzhou, Wei withdrew to Zhongling County. Shan came to persuade him to surrender, but Wei demanded that Guan Sheng invite him in person. Guan agreed, and Wei joined Liangshan with his troops. He ranked forty-fifth, corresponding to the Earthly Fierce Star, and served as a lesser cavalry commander and reconnaissance leader.

During the assault on Shezhou against Fang La, Wang Yin opened the gates over a concealed pit. Wei Dingguo and Shan Tinggui rushed inside and fell into it with their horses. Waiting troops killed both with spears and bows.
魏定国，凌州团练使，精熟火攻，号「神火将」，与善用水法的单廷珪同守凌州。朝廷命二.ja:
魏定国は凌州の団練使で、火攻めに熟達し、「神火将」と呼ばれた。水戦を得意とする単廷珪と凌州を守っていた。梁山泊征討を命じられると関勝の軍に迎え撃たれたが、赤と黒の鎧を着た歩兵で伏撃し、宣賛、郝思文を捕らえ、関勝を退かせた。

単廷珪が関勝に帰順した後も、魏定国は火兵を使って戦った。李逵らが凌州へ入ると中陵県へ退き、単廷珪の説得に対して、関勝本人が迎えに来ることを求めた。関勝が応じると、部下と梁山泊へ加わった。席次は第四十五位、地猛星に当たり、馬軍小彪将兼遠探出哨頭領を務めた。

方臘征討の歙州攻めでは、王寅が門を開け、内側に落とし穴を設けていた。魏定国と単廷珪は先を争って飛び込み、馬もろとも穴に落ち、伏兵の槍と弓で殺された。

武松，清河县人，排行第二，称「武二郎」。他在柴进庄上结识宋江，回乡途中醉过景阳冈.en:
Wu Song, the second son of a family from Qinghe County, was known as Second Brother Wu. He met Song Jiang at Chai Jin's estate. On his journey home, he crossed Jingyang Ridge after drinking and killed a tiger barehanded, earning appointment as constable in Yanggu. When Pan Jinlian and Ximen Qing poisoned his elder brother Wu Da, Wu Song gathered evidence but failed to obtain justice. He killed them in revenge, surrendered, and was exiled to Mengzhou.

There Shi En befriended him. Wu Song beat Jiang the Door God while drunk and recovered Happy Grove. Officials then framed him and arranged his murder at Flying Cloud Pool. He killed the escorts and assassins, returned to Mengzhou, and carried out the killings at Mandarin Duck Tower. Zhang Qing and Sun Erniang supplied a mendicant's clothes and papers so he could escape as a pilgrim. He joined Twin Dragons Mountain, then Liangshan after the combined mountain bands took Qingzhou.

Wu Song ranked fourteenth, corresponding to the Heavenly Wounded Star, and commanded infantry. During the Fang La campaign near Muzhou, Bao Daoyi's flying sword struck his left arm. Lu Zhishen rescued him. On regaining consciousness, Wu Song severed the nearly detached limb himself and was taken back to camp.

Returning to Hangzhou, Wu Song declined to go to court. He took religious vows at Six Harmonies Temple and cared for the ailing Lin Chong. The novel states that he lived to eighty.
武松，清河县人，排行第二，称「武二郎」。他在柴进庄上结识宋江，回乡途中醉过景阳冈.ja:
武松は清河県出身の次男で、「武二郎」と呼ばれた。柴進の屋敷で宋江と知り合い、帰郷の途中、酒を飲んで景陽岡を越え、素手で虎を倒したため陽穀県の都頭となる。兄の武大が潘金蓮と西門慶に毒殺されると、証拠を集めて訴えたが受け入れられず、二人を殺して仇を討ち、自首して孟州へ流された。

孟州では施恩に世話を受け、酔って蒋門神を打ち負かし、快活林を取り戻した。張都監らに陥れられ、飛雲浦で殺されかけると、護送役と刺客を返り討ちにして孟州へ戻り、鴛鴦楼で殺戮を行った。張青と孫二娘から頭陀の衣服と度牒を受けて行者に変装し、二竜山へ入る。後に三山の軍と青州を攻め、梁山泊に加わった。

席次は第十四位、天傷星に当たり、歩軍頭領を務めた。方臘征討で睦州付近へ進むと、包道乙の飛剣で左腕を傷つけられ、魯智深に救われた。意識を取り戻した武松は、切れかかった腕を自ら切り落とし、陣へ運ばれた。

杭州へ戻ると帰朝を望まず、六和寺で出家し、病気の林沖を世話した。原作には、後に八十歳で穏やかに世を去ったと記されている。

吴用，表字学究，道号加亮先生，绰号「智多星」，与晁盖自幼相识，在村中教书，也使两.en:
Wu Yong, courtesy name Xuejiu and styled Master Jialiang, was known as the Resourceful Star. A village teacher and Chao Gai's friend since childhood, he also wielded two copper chains. He helped plan the birthday-gift robbery and recruited the Ruan brothers. Chao Gai's seven men posed as date merchants, while Bai Sheng separately played the wine seller; drugged wine allowed them to seize the convoy's valuables.

At Liangshan, Wu Yong encouraged Lin Chong's discontent with Wang Lun's refusal to admit them. Lin Chong killed Wang Lun, and Chao Gai became leader. Wu Yong served as strategist in campaigns including Zhu Family Manor and Daming. Disguised as a fortune-teller, he wrote a poem with a concealed rebellious message at Lu Junyi's house and persuaded him to travel to avoid disaster, drawing him into Liangshan's scheme.

At the grand assembly, Wu Yong ranked third, corresponding to the Heavenly Intelligence Star, and shared responsibility for military strategy with Gongsun Sheng. After the amnesty he accompanied the campaigns and, following Fang La's defeat, was appointed military commissioner of Wusheng Army.

In a dream, Song Jiang and Li Kui told him they had been poisoned. Wu Yong went to Song Jiang's grave at Liaorwa in Chuzhou and met Hua Rong, drawn there by a similar dream. Remembering Song Jiang's kindness, they hanged themselves together from a tree beside the grave and were buried nearby.
吴用，表字学究，道号加亮先生，绰号「智多星」，与晁盖自幼相识，在村中教书，也使两.ja:
呉用は字を学究、道号を加亮先生といい、「智多星」と呼ばれた。幼い頃から晁蓋と親しく、村で学問を教え、二本の銅鎖も使った。生辰綱強奪の計画に加わって阮氏三兄弟を誘い、晁蓋ら七人を棗売りに、白勝を別に酒売りに仕立て、しびれ薬で護送役を倒して財物を奪った。

梁山泊では王倫の拒絶を機に林沖の不満をあおり、林沖が王倫を殺して晁蓋が寨主となった。その後は軍師として祝家荘、大名府などの戦いに関わった。占い師を装って盧俊義の家に反意を隠した詩を書き、災難を避ける旅に出るよう勧め、梁山泊の計略へ巻き込んだこともある。

大聚義では第三位、天機星に当たり、公孫勝と機密を扱う軍師を務めた。招安後も従軍し、方臘平定後は武勝軍承宣使に任ぜられた。

宋江と李逵が毒殺の冤罪を訴える夢を見た呉用は、楚州蓼児窪の宋江の墓へ向かい、同じく夢に導かれた花栄と会った。二人は宋江の恩義をしのび、ともに墓のそばの木で首をつり、その隣に葬られた。

项充，徐州沛县人，称「八臂哪吒」，在芒砀山与樊瑞、李衮聚义。他持团牌，背插二十四.en:
Xiang Chong, the Eight-Armed Nezha, came from Pei County in Xuzhou and joined Fan Rui and Li Gun at Mount Mangdang. He carried a round shield, twenty-four throwing knives on his back, and a javelin in his right hand. The three threatened to absorb Liangshan; when Shi Jin attacked first, Xiang Chong and Li Gun drove him back.

Song Jiang then brought another force, and Gongsun Sheng used formations and magic. Xiang Chong and Li Gun fell into pits and were captured. Song Jiang's courteous treatment won their surrender, and they returned to persuade Fan Rui to join as well. Xiang ranked sixty-fourth, corresponding to the Earthly Flying Star, and served as an infantry officer, often fighting with Li Gun as shield-bearers alongside Li Kui.

During the Fang La campaign near Muzhou, the three pursued Zheng Biao across a stream and were cut off by an ambush. As Xiang Chong withdrew toward the bank, a rope tripped him. The soldiers killed him before he could rise; Li Gun also died under arrows in the stream.
项充，徐州沛县人，称「八臂哪吒」，在芒砀山与樊瑞、李衮聚义。他持团牌，背插二十四.ja:
項充は徐州沛県の出身で、「八臂哪吒」と呼ばれ、芒碭山で樊瑞、李袞と仲間を集めた。丸盾を持ち、背に二十四本の飛刀を差し、右手に投槍を構えた。三人が梁山泊を併呑すると豪語すると、まず史進が討伐に来たが、項充と李袞に退けられた。

次に宋江が兵を率い、公孫勝が陣と術を用いた。項充と李袞は穴に落ちて捕らえられ、宋江の厚遇を受けて帰順し、山へ戻って樊瑞も説得した。席次は第六十四位、地飛星に当たり、歩軍将校として李袞と盾を使い、しばしば李逵と組んで戦った。

方臘征討で睦州付近に至ると、三人は鄭彪を追って川を渡り、伏兵に遮られた。項充は岸へ退くところで縄に足を取られ、起き上がる前に敵兵に殺された。李袞も川の中で矢を受けて死んだ。

萧让，济州秀才，能写苏、黄、米、蔡诸家字体，称「圣手书生」，也会枪棒刀剑。为伪造.en:
Xiao Rang was a scholar of Jizhou who could imitate the calligraphy of Su Shi, Huang Tingjian, Mi Fu, and Cai Jing, earning the name Master Calligrapher. He also practiced weapons. To forge a letter from Cai Jing and save Song Jiang, Wu Yong sent Dai Zong to hire Xiao Rang and the engraver Jin Dajian on the pretext of preparing a monument at the Mount Tai temple. They and their families were then brought to Liangshan.

Xiao Rang copied Cai Jing's handwriting, Jin Dajian made the seal, and Dai Zong carried the letter to Jiangzhou. Its signature and seal were inappropriate for a father's letter to his son, allowing Huang Wenbing to expose it. Song Jiang and Dai Zong were sentenced to execution and later rescued by the outlaws. Xiao Rang remained at Liangshan, ranked forty-sixth under the Earthly Literary Star, and handled proclamations, correspondence, and written military orders.

After the Wang Qing campaign and before the expedition against Fang La, Cai Jing demanded Xiao Rang's services as a scribe, and he left the army. At the novel's close, he is serving as a resident scholar in Cai Jing's household.
萧让，济州秀才，能写苏、黄、米、蔡诸家字体，称「圣手书生」，也会枪棒刀剑。为伪造.ja:
蕭譲は済州の秀才で、蘇軾、黄庭堅、米芾、蔡京の書をまねることができ、「聖手書生」と呼ばれた。槍棒や刀剣も使った。蔡京の返書を偽造して宋江を救うため、呉用は戴宗を遣わし、泰安岳廟の碑を作るという口実で、蕭譲と刻印師の金大堅を城外へ誘い、家族も梁山泊へ迎えた。

蕭譲が蔡京の筆跡で書き、金大堅が印を刻み、戴宗が江州へ持ち帰った。しかし署名の称号と印が父から息子への家書にふさわしくなく、黄文炳に見破られた。宋江と戴宗は処刑を命じられ、後に好漢たちの刑場襲撃で救われた。蕭譲は梁山泊に残り、第四十六位、地文星として、公文書や軍の命令書を担当した。

王慶平定後に帰京し、方臘征討へ出発する前、蔡京が代筆役として蕭譲を求めたため、軍を離れた。物語の末尾では、蔡太師の屋敷で門館先生を務めている。

解宝，登州猎户，解珍的弟弟，称「双尾蝎」，双腿刺飞天夜叉，善使钢叉。兄弟奉官限捕.en:
Xie Bao, the Twin-Tailed Scorpion, was a hunter from Dengzhou and Xie Zhen's younger brother. With flying demons tattooed on his legs, he wielded a steel hunting fork. Ordered to kill a tiger, the brothers wounded it with a poisoned trap arrow, but it fell into Squire Mao's garden. The Mao household claimed the tiger and reward, then colluded with clerk Wang Zheng to frame the hunters for robbery and imprison them.

Yue He carried their message to their relatives. Gu Dasao, Sun Xin, Sun Li, Zou Yuan, and Zou Run helped break them out. The group then headed for Liangshan, entered Zhu Family Manor through Sun Li's connection with Luan Tingyu, and helped take it from within. Xie Bao ranked thirty-fifth, corresponding to the Heavenly Weeping Star, and commanded infantry.

Against Fang La, Xie Bao and his brother volunteered to climb Black Dragon Ridge at night and set a fire. Xie Zhen was hoisted by a grappling hook and fell after cutting it. Xie Bao tried to retreat but came under falling rocks and crossbow fire. Arrows shot through the bamboo and vines killed him.
解宝，登州猎户，解珍的弟弟，称「双尾蝎」，双腿刺飞天夜叉，善使钢叉。兄弟奉官限捕.ja:
解宝は登州の猟師で、解珍の弟に当たり、「双尾蠍」と呼ばれた。両脚に飛天夜叉を彫り、鋼叉を使った。兄弟は役所から虎狩りを命じられ、仕掛けた毒矢を当てたが、虎は毛太公の裏庭へ落ちた。毛家は虎と褒賞を横取りし、孔目の王正と結託して兄弟を強盗として投獄させた。

楽和が身内に知らせ、顧大嫂、孫新、孫立、鄒淵、鄒潤らが牢を破って救った。一行は梁山泊へ向かい、孫立と欒廷玉の関係を使って祝家荘へ潜入し、内応して攻略した後、仲間に加わる。解宝は第三十五位、天哭星に当たり、歩軍頭領を務めた。

方臘征討では兄と夜の烏竜嶺を登り、火を放つ役を志願した。解珍が鉤で吊られ、それを切って崖から落ちると、解宝は急いで退いたが、落石と弩矢を浴び、竹や蔓の間から放たれた矢で殺された。
